meta.name: track-management
meta.description: Use this skill when creating, managing, or working with Conductor tracks - the logical work units for features, bugs, and refactors. Applies to spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理功能、缺陷和重构的开发工作单元与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发时需要把功能、缺陷和重构整理成有文档的工作单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize features, bugs, and refactors into trackable work units
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break dev work into tracked units with specs and plans

howto.what: Claude 会按 Conductor 的方式帮你创建和管理 track(功能、bug、重构的工作单元),产出并维护 spec.md 和 plan.md,覆盖从创建到完成的整个生命周期。
howto.when: 当你新建或管理功能、bug、重构类的 track,或需要处理 spec.md、plan.md 与 track 生命周期时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个功能 track,并写 spec.md
say.note: Claude 会按规范创建 track 与规格文件

say.text: 把 plan.md 拆成 3-5 个任务的阶段,加上验证任务
say.note: 按实践建议控制阶段大小并留验证步骤

say.text: 把这个已完成的 track 归档,不要删除
say.note: 完成的 track 会被保留作参考

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will create and manage Conductor tracks — the work units for features, bugs, and refactors — producing and maintaining spec.md and plan.md across the whole track lifecycle, following its 10 best-practice rules.
howto.when_en: Use it when you create or manage a feature, bug, or refactor track, or work with spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

say_en.text: Create a new feature track and write its spec.md.
say_en.note: Claude sets up the track and spec file.

say_en.text: Split plan.md into phases of 3-5 tasks, with verification tasks.
say_en.note: Keeps phases small per the listed practices.

say_en.text: Archive this completed track instead of deleting it.
say_en.note: Completed tracks are kept for reference.
